independent_derivations.claim: The exact mass equations are the actual MINI equations, including bubbles and weak pressure rows.
independent_derivations.derivation: With b=27 lambda1 lambda2 lambda3, its moments are mean b=9/20, mean b lambda_i=3/20 and mean b^2=81/280. Bubble elimination subtracts 7/90 from each affine mass coefficient: diagonal 1/6 becomes 4/45 and off-diagonal 1/12 becomes 1/180. The pressure coupling correction is 7/30, leaving 1/10. The pressure block is -(7/10)|K| grad lambda_i dot grad lambda_j. These are mass/gradient blocks, not scalar stiffness substitutes. For the mean-one bubble beta=(20/9)b, gamma=10/7 and its exact momentum equation is grad p=-mean_beta W. This gives ||grad p+c||<=sqrt(gamma)||W-c|| on any source-free parent region.
independent_derivations.consequence: Every later pressure-gradient or restoration estimate controls a real source-free MINI response, not a pressure-free surrogate.

independent_derivations.claim: The incoming-field estimate retains both neutral layers, shallow-source terms and actual source-height contacts.
independent_derivations.derivation: The normalized inverse gives pressure (-c Q-h dot F)/L, with physical stable/unstable residues -Q/(2t)-(i sign(theta)/2)F_t +/- F_n/2 plus the stated higher terms. Multiplying by physical pressure scale h restores actual row units. The physical velocity is (-i theta,+/-t) times its pressure residue. Its source-height jump is a smooth constant for a scalar row source and smooth linear theta polynomials for velocity sources; a cutoff polynomial is rapidly decaying horizontally. Consequently first velocity differences have scalar/velocity-source orders one/two, and physical pressure second differences have the same distant scales A/R^2+B/R^3. The direct pressure-free c-root is retained. Its shallow-source boundary matching has an analytic order-zero part plus a one-sided order-one remainder; multiplying by a root/vector correction of order theta raises the nonsmooth order, rather than incorrectly discarding the analytic constant. The exact zero base data then fix both target neutral-layer coefficients. With c=v_ph(0), they are -c_t,-c_n up to O(h K_*), p_ph(0)=h k_n c_n+O(h^2 K_*), and c_t=O(h K_*). The normal component is independent and can be order one on its natural scale.
independent_derivations.consequence: After setting h<=r^2/R, the physical nodal velocity remainder is O(r K_*), pressure remainder O(r^2 K_*), and the pressure-gradient and full-bubble velocity collar norms are O(r^2 K_*). The latter follows from the exact bubble coefficient difference, not from differentiating a thin pressure value bound twice. For distant base velocity, the first nonsmooth boundary multiplier is order theta and the analytic local part is separated; its effective physical source is h times the base-velocity L1 norm.

independent_derivations.claim: Passive stability and the compact cutoff preserve every weak moment and the actual near-field self-response.
independent_derivations.derivation: For homogeneous prescribed data and residuals F,ell bounded by f||z|| and l||grad q||, solve (grad chi,grad q)=ell(q), take beta grad chi cellwise, and subtract that actual zero-trace bubble field from velocity. Its norm is sqrt(gamma)l. The kernel test gives ||v||<=f+2sqrt(gamma)l; the bubble right inverse gives ||grad p||<=sqrt(gamma)(f+||v||). These bounds are independent of child depth and cell angles. The uniform-annulus cutoff uses the full symmetric nodal-plus-bubble mixed matrix, giving R=[A,J]d. Since J is identity near the actual child, no equation or interpolation on fictitious uniform cells inside the coarse child is used. Coefficient-product estimates bound both momentum and weak-pressure commutators. Pressure tests vanish on the prescribed flat comparison base, so the local anchored Poincare estimate is legitimate. Applying the bubble stability bound controls the complete self-consistent correction, with no uncontrolled inverse of a child DtN.
independent_derivations.consequence: A nonzero weak-moment vector is carried through the solve; its scalar sum is never substituted for that vector. The radiation operator uses finite-energy scattered correction to infinite neutral plane layers, not a global L2 norm of the plane layers or a finite far-Dirichlet operator.

independent_derivations.claim: The pressure trace split is affine-equivariant and controls every actual guard breakpoint.
independent_derivations.derivation: Across every radial edge, D[N]+y[T]=0. Thus G=T+D(N-N0)/y is absolutely continuous with derivative -D(N-N0)/y^2 for every constant N0. One-dimensional Poincare and contraction of mean subtraction yield ||T-mean T||<=C(D/Y)||N-N0||. The actual chosen extractor is mean T, the chord slope; mean G is only an intermediate estimate. Using exact fan area D dy/2 gives R||gprime||^2+R^-1||g||^2<=C(RD/Y^2)E_patch^2 for the anchored remainder g. The child-scale S correction replaces the local |x| kink by |x-y| (and its reflected counterpart) while being affine on each whole recursive hole. It introduces no eighth child boundary point. All remaining g breakpoints are actual uniform-lattice lines outside the unrefined child base, and the transition is conformed to those fixed interfaces before the coefficients are known. Hence the lift is by prescribed affine gradients there and fixed-shape uniform interpolation only, never by an unproved skinny-mesh nodal stability statement.
independent_derivations.consequence: The whole pressure-lift energy squared is bounded by C b0(a/N)^2 E_patch^2. This includes extra guard values, not merely a three-node kink. Adding an affine Darcy state changes only the extracted affine macro; g, its pressure lift and all residual norms are unchanged.

independent_derivations.claim: All-vector velocity errors have the separately paid center/corner/guard budget.
independent_derivations.derivation: The reduced nodal mass Gram is C=(1/12)I+(1/180)11^T with inverse 12I-(2/3)11^T. Therefore |K||a_i-a_j||^2<=24||W-c||_K^2 for arbitrary vector components. The exact trace mass comparison yields integral_edge|g-c|^2<=32/(3D)||W-c||_K^2. Choose the incident velocity equal to the actual child-center velocity, making its center error exactly zero. Every corner error is then charged using the SINGLE adjoining parent base triangle and the independently imposed ratio S_corner<=epsilon_corner |K|. Uniform guards have actual exterior stars O(h^2); finite edge mass gives their total cost C[h/D+hR/(rD)]E_patch^2<=C h/(sigma D)E_patch^2. This proves sum_i||Eg_i||^2<=C eta_base E^2 with eta_base=epsilon_corner+max h/(sigma D). It controls normal endpoint patterns as well as tangential ones; no normal pressure continuity inference is needed.

independent_derivations.claim: Nested tails and restored pairs yield an exact same-operator per-child decomposition.
independent_derivations.derivation: The pressure and velocity lift cutoffs equal one through 4R and vanish beyond 8R; every bulk commutator stencil lies below 3R. Thus no unlifted base source lies on a bulk stencil. The far pressure tail has Fp<=C R^(3/2)||gprime||. Its whole annulus norm is C Fp/R<=C Qp, and its child residual is C(r/R)^2 Qp. The velocity tail has Fv<=C sqrt(R/(sigma D))E_patch; its effective far source hFv gives whole-ring squared cost C h^2/(sigma D R)E_patch^2, no larger than the paid guard budget. Its macro and both neutral layers are retained. The local pressure correction is restored as (wcorr,pcorr+Phi); the velocity correction as (waux+Eg,paux). Their momentum loads cancel exactly and Eg has no weak-pressure load, so their restrictions are actual source-free child states. The bulk residual is supported only in the common annulus, outside the child. The incoming affine macro and the two radiation driver amplitudes include all tail increments. The entire correction uses the same E_infinity(D), radiation J_infinity and incident F_infinity as the ideal projection, retaining all output base/interface reactions.

No inner monopole is assumed zero: the outgoing near source remains in the child/radiation solve and every distant scalar moment is handled by the half-plane Green calculation.

independent_derivations.claim: The all-state complementary-row normalization is exactly (A).
independent_derivations.derivation: Subtract the quotient background first. The chord slope on a ring costs at most C(R/D)E_patch^2 in squared ring norm, obtained by Cauchy-Schwarz along the base with area D dy/2. A constant short layer at the actual center costs C hR/(rD)E_patch^2 and is within eta_base. Parent rings and their charged patches have bounded overlap, so the sum of squared bulk driver norms is C E^2. Localized full-field scattering gives sum_i||e_bulk,i||_physical^2<=C sigma^4 E^2. The independently restored base velocities cost C eta_base E^2, and pressure lifts cost C b0(a/N)^2 E^2. A child-reference L2 norm is its physical norm divided by r. Hence the mean response remainder norm is at most C/(r sqrt(B)) times the square root of the summed physical energies. With r~sigma b0 a H/N and B~N^2/(b0 a), r sqrt(B)/H~sigma sqrt(b0 a). The three contributions are therefore C sigma/sqrt(b0 a), C sqrt(eta_base)/(sigma sqrt(b0 a)), and C sqrt(a)/(N sigma). This derivation controls Q U on every odd input state, not only Q U P.

independent_derivations.claim: The exterior parity limit can be used after fixed N without a hidden h-dependent inverse.
independent_derivations.derivation: Only inner pressure traces zero at the two base corners are used; four free pressure coefficients and eight free velocities give the actual compatible twelve-port problem. Exterior boundary stars shrink, while fixed macro pressure lifts remain in every refined space. The exterior velocity spaces approximate all L2 and the zero-boundary gradient spaces converge by local H1 compactness/Hardy control and smooth recovery away from shrinking collars. Bubble corrections turn velocity recovery into kernel recovery, so the exterior DtN converges to the reflection-invariant continuous Darcy map. The radiation driver tends to zero through its compact neutral-layer residual, not through an L2 estimate of an infinite plane layer. Original INTERNAL child boundary stars remain positive independent of h, so the child signed energy bounds all free coefficients by a fixed c_N. Thus the glued free inverse is bounded by 1/c_N both for finite-h exterior and the limiting exterior, even while D_h varies. The resolvent identity makes the E_h(D_h)-E_0(D_h) estimate uniform along the actual family. Actual center coefficients and regular incoming field extractors have finite N-dependent but h-independent bounds from parent fan triangles and ring energy. One may therefore shrink h once after N to achieve the parity budget, then keep the finite template fixed with recursive depth.
